title: The tarp, off early
logline: The lawn chair's tarp off in March, a month early, folded with its stone, and the chair not yet moved to the dock's end. Three weeks before it is. The page prepares the chair without knowing for what.

panels.composition: An old lawn chair on a dock in March with a folded blue tarp and a stone beside it, the chair still in its place by the shingle shack, gray light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an old lawn chair on a wooden dock in March with a folded blue tarp and a stone beside it, the chair still beside a shingle shack, gray light, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
